title: Add website template: Tailwind CSS via CDN
description: Create a base HTML layout PHP template that includes Tailwind CSS via CDN script tag and a content placeholder block.
acceptanceCriteria: Tailwind CSS CDN script tag is included
{{CONTENT}} or PHP include placeholder is present for page content

steps.details: Create src/templates/website/templates/layout.php: <!DOCTYPE html><html lang='en'><head><meta charset='UTF-8'><meta name='viewport' content='width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0'><title><?= $title ?? '{{PROJECT_NAME}}' ?></title><script src='https://cdn.tailwindcss.com'></script></head><body class='bg-gray-50 text-gray-900'><?php if (isset($content)) echo $content; ?></body></html>
Update src/templates/website/templates/home.php to use the layout. Set $title and $content variables, then include layout.php.

technicalNotes: CDN Tailwind is fine for prototypes but should be replaced with a build step for production
{{PROJECT_NAME}} in the title tag will be replaced by the template engine during scaffolding
